title: A Cube’s Choice Demo is now live on Steam!
author: JechoEntertainment
selftext:
I finally released the Steam demo for **A Cube’s Choice**!

It’s a fast-paced 3D movement/platforming game built in Unreal Engine 5. The game focuses on momentum, music, strange abstract environments, and a softer philosophical story about a cube trying to figure out who it is.

I’ve also used AI during development, primarily for things like **images/art assets and music**, alongside the rest of the game development work in UE5.

I’ve been working on this for quite a while and recently rebuilt the trailer based on feedback, so I’d really appreciate any thoughts on the gameplay, presentation, or how the AI-assisted parts fit into the overall project.

**Free Steam Demo:**  
[https://store.steampowered.com/app/4866610/A\_Cubes\_Choice/](https://store.steampowered.com/app/4866610/A_Cubes_Choice/)
